semiconductor_relevance: High — Glint Materials specializes in innovative dry adhesive pads specifically designed for precise substrate handling in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Glint Materials Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures high friction dry adhesive pads, known as SurfCon®, tailored for the semiconductor and display industries. Their technology addresses common handling issues such as sliding and misalignment, providing a unique solution that enhances substrate handling efficiency.
capabilities: High friction dry adhesive non-slip pads
Manufactured with semiconductor compliance materials (POLMA®, CONEPOL®)
Custom material solutions based on technical requirements
